#include "trmm.h"

void kernel_trmm(double alpha, double A[20][20], double B[20][30]) {
    // B = alpha * A * B
    // A is lower triangular with unit diagonal, multiplication from left
    // Compute in-place from bottom row to top to avoid overwriting needed values
    for (int i = 19; i >= 0; i--) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 30; j++) {
            double sum = 0.0;
            // dot product of row i of A (up to diagonal) with column j of B
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++) {
                sum += A[i][k] * B[k][j];
            }
            // diagonal of A is 1, so add B[i][j] and scale by alpha
            B[i][j] = alpha * (B[i][j] + sum);
        }
    }
}

#include "trmm.h"

void kernel_trmm(double alpha, double A[20][20], double B[20][30]) {
    // HLS interfaces
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE m_axi port=A offset=slave bundle=gmem
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE m_axi port=B offset=slave bundle=gmem
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE s_axilite port=alpha bundle=control
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE s_axilite port=return bundle=control

    // Local buffers for A and B
    double A_local[20][20];
    double B_local[20][30];

    // Partition local arrays for parallel access
    #pragma HLS ARRAY_PARTITION variable=A_local cyclic factor=4 dim=1
    #pragma HLS ARRAY_PARTITION variable=A_local cyclic factor=4 dim=2
    #pragma HLS ARRAY_PARTITION variable=B_local cyclic factor=4 dim=1
    #pragma HLS ARRAY_PARTITION variable=B_local cyclic factor=4 dim=2

    // Copy A to local memory
    for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
            #pragma HLS PIPELINE II=1
            A_local[i][j] = A[i][j];
        }
    }

    // Copy B to local memory
    for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 30; j++) {
            #pragma HLS PIPELINE II=1
            B_local[i][j] = B[i][j];
        }
    }

    // Triangular matrix multiplication: B = alpha * A * B
    // A is lower triangular with unit diagonal (DIAG='U')
    for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 30; j++) {
            #pragma HLS PIPELINE II=1
            double sum = 0.0;
            for (int k = 0; k <= i; k++) {
                #pragma HLS UNROLL
                // Unit diagonal: use 1.0 when k == i, otherwise use A_local[i][k]
                double a_val = (k == i) ? 1.0 : A_local[i][k];
                sum += a_val * B_local[k][j];
            }
            B_local[i][j] = alpha * sum;
        }
    }

    // Copy result back to B
    for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 30; j++) {
            #pragma HLS PIPELINE II=1
            B[i][j] = B_local[i][j];
        }
    }
}

void kernel_trmm(double alpha, double A[20][20], double B[20][30]) {
    // Process rows from bottom to top to allow in-place update
    // using the original B values for the multiplication.
    for (int i = 19; i >= 0; i--) {
        double sum[30];
        // Initialize accumulation array to zero
        for (int j = 0; j < 30; j++) {
            sum[j] = 0.0;
        }
        // Compute sum over k for the lower triangular part of A
        for (int k = 0; k <= i; k++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 30; j++) {
                sum[j] += A[i][k] * B[k][j];
            }
        }
        // Scale by alpha and write back to B
        for (int j = 0; j < 30; j++) {
            B[i][j] = alpha * sum[j];
        }
    }
}

#include "trmm.h"

void kernel_trmm(double alpha, double A[20][20], double B[20][30]) {
    // Temporary buffer for a column of B to preserve original values
    double col[20];

    // Process each column of B independently
    for (int j = 0; j < 30; j++) {
        // Copy original column j into local buffer
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            col[i] = B[i][j];
        }

        // Compute new B column: B[i][j] = alpha * (col[i] + sum_{k=0}^{i-1} A[i][k] * col[k])
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            double sum = col[i]; // contribution from unit diagonal of A
            // Dot product with strictly lower part of row i of A
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++) {
                sum += A[i][k] * col[k];
            }
            B[i][j] = alpha * sum;
        }
    }
}
